title: OK That Anti-Trans Essay and OSUs Shame
author: Peter Greene
summary: A University of Oklahoma student submitted a reaction paper that failed to demonstrate she had actually read the assigned article, instead using the assignment as a platform for anti-trans ideology. The graduate teaching assistant, who is trans, marked her down for not meeting the assignment's core requirement: proving comprehension through specific textual references. The incident escalated when the student, her mother (an attorney connected to January 6 defense), and right-wing political figures weaponized the failing grade as an example of academic persecution, prompting the university to abdicate responsibility by restoring the student's grade and protecting her from any academic consequences.
points: The assignment explicitly required students to demonstrate they had read the assigned article by including specific references; Fulnecky failed to meet this basic requirement.
The student's response was a personal ideological manifesto rather than a reaction paper, with vague references and no textual evidence of engagement with actual course material.
Her mother, a lawyer with ties to January 6 defendants, immediately escalated the grade dispute through political and media channels rather than through normal academic appeal procedures.
Oklahoma State University capitulated by assuring the student of no academic harm, undermining the instructor and validating the politicization of grading standards.
quotes: Please note that I am not deducting points because you have certain beliefs, but instead I am deducting points for you posting a reaction paper that does not answer the questions for this assignment, contradicts itself, heavily uses personal ideology over empirical evidence in a scientific class, and is at times offensive.

Fulnecky didn't meet that requirement. Teachers will recognize the sort of constructions she used. This article is very thought-provoking and caused me to thoroughly evaluate the idea of gender and the role it plays in our society.
In other words, Mom has fully mastered the art of aggressive victimhood. So maybe Samantha Fulnecky is really upset about her grade. Or maybe she is launching a career in the moral panic industry.
But meanwhile, Oklahoma State University has shamed itself by benching Curth and ensuring no academic harm to the student from the graded assignments.
I know Oklahoma State University is in Oklahoma, but surely they can do better than bending to this kind of baloney.” Archived from Curmudgucation on April 20, 2026 by Tim.
